items.docs: The `posts` collection is registered and anonymously readable but EMPTY — verified `X-WP-Total: 0` on 2026-08-04. Kartos Therapeutics runs no blog and maintains no press-release archive as WordPress posts; its scientific record lives in the `presentation` custom post type instead.
